text: {"question":"Which part of the neutron lifetime measurements described in the second passage provides evidence that the empirical calibration of the primordial helium fraction can make cosmological constraints independent of theoretical big‑bang nucleosynthesis assumptions?","reference_answer":"The discussion of the neutron lifetime—particularly the comparison between bottle and beam experiments and the resulting impact on the free neutron fraction that determines the helium yield—shows that uncertainties in BBN inputs (like the neutron lifetime) can be constrained empirically, supporting the claim that LBT’s helium measurement allows cosmological analyses to be agnostic to BBN theory."}
